36 Ladder Door Pull with 24 Center to Centers

text.description_html:
Modern 36" Glass Door Ladder Pull

The 24 Inch Center to Center Ladder Shower Door Pull has an overall length of 36 inches, making it a great choice for large glass doors or those located in large rooms. Perfect for use as shower door handles, these contemporary pulls can also be used on glass doors in offices. It comes packaged as 2 pulls with back-to-back mounting and the hardware for glass door installation. Choose from satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching 36" Ladder Pull for metal or wood doors.

Specifications and Features of the 36" Glass Door Pull:

  • Overall Length: 36"
  • Mounting Length: 24" Center to Center
  • Pull Diameter: 3/4" Round Tubing
  • Mounting Point Diameter: 27/32"
  • Overall Projection: 2-15/32"
  • Clearance: 1-1/32"
  • Inner Contact Tubing: 5/6" (16 mm)
  • For 5/16" (8 mm) to 1/2" (12 mm) thick glass
  • Comes packaged as a back-to-back pair with mounting hardware for Glass Door.

Sold as a Pair (2 door pull handles) for Glass Door.
